title: Melissa & Doug Poke-a-Dot! What’s Your Favorite Color? Interactive Children's Board Book with Buttons to Pop, Educational Sensory Toy for Toddlers & Preschoolers Ages 3+ - FSC Certified
features: Engaging Sensory Play: 20-page children's book features built-in buttons that make satisfying “pop” sounds with every press, turning reading into a sensory-rich, hands-on, interactive adventure for toddlers and preschoolers

Colorful Counting Fun: Poke the dots to count animals and discover colors from purple to green; designed to support language development, boost color recognition, counting skills, and fine motor development
Sized Just Right for Little Hands: Durable board book pages and chunky poke-able buttons are designed for small hands to grasp, press, and explore independently
Travel-Friendly: Sturdy, compact design fits easily in backpacks or carry-ons for screen-free entertainment on road trips, airplanes, and outings
Perfect Gift for Preschoolers – A great educational gift for birthdays, holidays, back-to-school, or classroom rewards—ideal for curious learners ages 3 to 11
